data.message: I can help reduce the gap for CS-Year2-A on Wednesdays. Here's my suggestion:

proposal.description: Move CS101 Theory from Monday Period 1 to Wednesday Period 3
proposal.explanation: Moving this lecture from Monday to Wednesday fills the gap between the Math101 Theory (P1-P2) and the CS101 Lab (P5-P6) on Wednesdays, reducing the student gap penalty from 3 to 0 for this group on that day.
